title: Scientists discover metals that defy the deep freeze at -424°F
caption:
Engineers have discovered a way to stop metals from shattering in the extreme cold of deep space. By using 'nanoscale twinning,' these experimental alloys create new internal pathways to stay flexible when other materials would snap.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover metals that defy the deep freeze at -424°F

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261029072127.htm
